title: Forward-migration database backups are never pruned (backups/dive-v<N>-<ts>.db accumulate student data indefinitely)
notes: db/mod.rs writes a full copy before each forward migration and nothing deletes them. S-078 now scrubs replay rows from new backups, but every other table (conversations, PRD drafts, EventLog) persists in each backup forever. Needs a retention policy (e.g. keep the last N).
